description: Item (armor/gear/consumables) registry - see CLAUDE.md's Item (Armor/Gear/Consumables) section for authoring guidelines.

items.name: Minor Health Potion
items.description: A small vial of watered-down healing draught. Restores a modest amount of HP with no lingering effect.

items.name: Health Potion
items.description: A ruby-red draught that knits wounds and quickens the body's own recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Stamina Potion
items.description: A fizzing, citrus-sharp brew that restores vigor and quickens stamina recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Mana Potion
items.description: A shimmering blue draught that replenishes magical reserves and quickens mana recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: Bandages
items.description: Clean cloth wrappings for a field dressing. Mundane, reliable, and safe to use as often as you have them.

items.name: Torch
items.description: A length of pitch-soaked wood, ready to be lit. No mechanical light rules yet - carry it for the flavor and the occasional Survival check by torchlight.

items.name: Half-Eaten Candy Bar
items.description: Half a candy bar in a crumpled wrapper. A little stale, but the sugar helps.

items.name: Canned Beans
items.description: A dented can, label long gone. Still sealed, still good.

items.name: Duct Tape Roll
items.description: Silver tape that fixes nearly anything for about five minutes. Never leave home without it.

items.name: Coil of Rope
items.description: A length of sturdy rope, coiled and ready. Useful for climbing, hauling, or tying someone down.

items.name: Reading Glasses
items.description: A pair of scratched reading glasses. Makes fine print, old inscriptions, and faded labels a lot easier to parse.

items.name: Painkillers
items.description: A half-empty bottle of over-the-counter pills. Mundane, reliable, and safe to use as often as you have them.

items.name: Pocket Flashlight
items.description: A cheap plastic flashlight with a wobbly beam. No mechanical light rules yet - carry it for the flavor and the occasional Survival check in the dark.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: An ice-cold can of something neon and caffeinated. Restores vigor and quickens recovery for a short while after drinking.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.description: A proper trauma kit, gauze and antiseptic and all. Restores a solid chunk of HP and quickens recovery for a short while after use.

items.name: Smartphone
items.description: A cracked but functional smartphone. Maps, cameras, and a signal when you're lucky - handy for noticing things you'd otherwise miss.

items.name: Field Trauma Kit
items.description: A professional paramedic's kit, fully stocked. Whoever lost this knew what they were doing.

items.name: Titanium Multitool
items.description: A sturdy folding multitool with a dozen attachments. Somehow still in the box, tucked behind a shelf.
